name: Just Be Patient
source:
Just Be Patient is a short psychological horror visual novel about tension, control, and a toxic doctor-patient relationship.

After a late shift at the diner, a familiar voice follows you into the dark. What starts as a simple walk home quickly spirals into something far more unsettling.

Trapped in an unfamiliar environment with someone who knows far too much about you, you’re forced to make choices that shape you, your experience, and your fate.

[From [url=https://hexedhoney.itch.io/just-be-patient]Itch.io[/url]]
